document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Tibor Gliere’s suicide stunned Miskatonic University. The 
disappearance of Professor Grunewald under suspicious 
circumstances has set rumors flying. Dean Wilcox is puzzled, upset, 
and unwilling to give an interview, but his secretary confides that 
Dean Wilcox hasn’t a clue as to what is going on. Go to 60.
(60)
